title: Mold Remediation Lead-Safe and Asbestos Sampling Fee Sheet
content:
Regulated-material figures for Mold Remediation jobs, by tier. Both fees are charged per job; both cutoffs are years built.

| Item | Spot | Limited | Standard | Extensive | Attic and Crawlspace | HVAC System |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Lead-safe setup fee, per job (USD) | 345.00 | 345.00 | 345.00 | 395.00 | 345.00 | 345.00 |
| RRP year-built cutoff (built before this year) | 1978 | 1978 | 1978 | 1978 | 1978 | 1978 |
| Asbestos sampling fee, per job (USD) | 425.00 | 425.00 | 425.00 | 595.00 | 425.00 | 425.00 |
| Asbestos sampling year cutoff (built before this year) | 1981 | 1981 | 1981 | 1981 | 1981 | 1981 |

**Lead-safe setup fee.** Lead-safe work practice setup, per job.

**RRP year-built cutoff.** Housing built before this year triggers lead-safe practices when painted surfaces are disturbed (EPA RRP pre-1978 housing). The cutoff is 1978 on every tier.

**Asbestos sampling fee.** Pre-removal asbestos sampling, collection plus lab, per job.

**Asbestos sampling year cutoff.** Buildings built before this year are sampled for asbestos before drywall, texture or insulation removal; this is company policy. The cutoff is 1981 on every tier.

| Building built in (hypothetical) | Before the RRP cutoff of 1978 | Before the asbestos cutoff of 1981 |
|---|---|---|
| 1976 | Yes | Yes |
| 1978 | No | Yes |
| 1980 | No | Yes |
| 1981 | No | No |

Extensive Mold Remediation carries the higher figures, 395.00 for lead-safe setup and 595.00 for asbestos sampling; every other tier carries 345.00 and 425.00.
